name: comp-507

frames.best_why: All of October is shaded from 1 to 31 with the Last month preset hovered.

tagline: Calendar with preset range buttons for common reporting periods.
summary: A bordered panel pairing a column of range shortcuts (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days, Last month and more) with a month calendar. Presets jump the month and shade their span while future days stay greyed out.
appearance: A black panel split by a divider: the left strip stacks eight small text buttons, the right holds "November 2026" between angle arrows, weekday initials and day numbers. Chosen ranges get white circular ends and a grey band, and days after today are dimmed.
behaviour: Pressing a shortcut repaints the calendar for that period: Last month fills all of October and moves the month back. Picking days by hand sets new ends, and clicking elsewhere on the grid restarts the range.
demo_content: November 2026 set to the last seven days, then October 2026 with the whole month chosen.
search_phrases: date range picker with quick presets
last 7 days and last month shortcuts
choose a reporting period from a list
calendar range with future days disabled
quick date range menu beside calendar
pick this month or year to date
use_when: People mostly want standard reporting periods and only occasionally a made-up span.
avoid_when: Only past dates can be chosen, so it cannot be reused for booking or scheduling ahead.
customise: The eight preset labels and the last-seven-days default are written in the file; changing presets, the past-only rule or the caption is a source edit.
weight_why: A single month grid and eight text buttons; nothing animates.

a11y.note: Presets are plain text buttons with no pressed state, so a screen reader cannot tell which range is active.

issues: No preset shows which range is currently selected.
Future days are disabled but nothing states why they cannot be clicked.
The caption credits the calendar library instead of describing the filter.
polish_why: Clear split of presets and calendar with a readable range band; presets lack an active state.
title: Date Range Preset Picker
